hosting._comment: Publishes docs/legal/. A reachable Privacy Policy, Terms and Support page are required for submission, and the URLs the app links to (AppConfiguration.swift) resolved to a 'Coming Soon' catch-all. Hosting is available on the free Spark plan, so this needs no billing and no DNS — to move to middleground.app later, add the custom domain in the Firebase console and change the one constant in AppConfiguration.
hosting._comment_public: Hosting refuses a public directory outside the project root (where this file lives), and the pages are authored at repo-root docs/legal. The predeploy step stages them here; `public/` is generated and gitignored, so docs/legal stays the single source.
hosting._comment_resource_dir: $RESOURCE_DIR is the public directory itself, not the project root — copying into "$RESOURCE_DIR/public" silently nests it one level and every path 404s.
